## XPO Named a 2027 FreightTech 100 Company by FreightWaves


September 21, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.xpo.com/node/22036/pdf)


GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[XPO](http://www.xpo.com/) (NYSE: XPO), a leading provider of freight transportation in North America, has been named to the 2027 FreightTech 100 list by FreightWaves, a global provider of supply chain market intelligence. XPO has been included on the FreightTech 100 every year since the inception of the list, which recognizes the most innovative companies in the freight transportation industry.


XPO’s operations are powered by cloud-based proprietary technologies that enable agility, efficiency and speed. Over the past year, the company has continued to introduce new AI applications while scaling proven tools across its network. These advances include broader deployment of AI-powered pickup-and-delivery route optimization, as well as new load photo analysis technology that gives frontline employees real-time feedback on trailer load quality.


Jay Silberkleit, chief information officer of XPO, said, “Being named to the FreightTech 100 reflects our industry-leading technology and culture of continuous innovation. We're building proprietary solutions that deliver actionable insights to our employees, helping us move freight more efficiently and deliver better service for our customers."


The FreightTech 100 list was selected from hundreds of nominations by a panel of FreightWaves journalists, market analysts and researchers. XPO is one of only 11 companies that have made the list every year since 2020.


**About XPO**
XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO) is a leader in asset-based less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation in North America. The company’s customer-focused organization efficiently moves 16 billion pounds of freight per year, enabled by its proprietary technology. XPO serves 55,000 customers with 586 locations and 38,000 employees in North America and Europe, and is headquartered in Greenwich, Conn., USA.
